name: Complete 75-category master feature register
scope: The 75 categories below are the authoritative scope map. The feature bullets preserve the detailed requirements supplied for each category while grouping related capabilities for readability.

name: Pharmacy and Laboratory Management
scope: Medicine catalogue/classification, prescriptions/dispensing, batches/expiry, stock, suppliers, pricing and billing; lab catalogue, sample registration/tracking, processing, result validation, reports, doctor access, equipment, inventory and quality control.

name: Finance, SACCO, Microfinance and Chama
scope: Members/KYC; savings, deposits, withdrawals, shares/contributions; groups; loan products/applications/assessment/approval/disbursement; interest, penalties, schedules and repayments; guarantors/collateral; statements, delinquency/restructuring, dividends, portfolio/risk reports, M-Pesa/banks, member portals, meetings, voting/resolutions and AI insights.

name: HR and Payroll
scope: Employee profiles, recruitment/ATS, onboarding/contracts, departments/positions, attendance/biometrics, shifts, leave/overtime/timesheets, payroll, allowances/deductions/payslips/payments, configurable PAYE/NSSF/SHIF/AHL statutory rules, tax reports, appraisals, training, discipline, self-service and analytics.

name: Property Management
scope: Properties/buildings/units; tenants/landlords; leases; rent invoices/collections/reconciliation; deposits/utilities; maintenance/inspections; communication; renewals/arrears; expenses/contractors; reports and tenant/landlord portals.

name: Hotel Management
scope: Rooms/availability/reservations; check-in/out; guest profiles; pricing; housekeeping; restaurant integration; billing/deposits/M-Pesa; invoices; staff/maintenance; reviews; occupancy/revenue analytics and booking portal.

name: Restaurant Management
scope: Menus; tables/reservations; orders; kitchen display/tickets; waiter/cashier; delivery/takeaway; POS; ingredient stock, recipes/costing/food-cost; suppliers/procurement; loyalty/discounts; M-Pesa, tax invoices and sales reports.

name: Services Management
scope: Service catalogue/bookings/appointments; job cards/work orders; technician assignment; tasks/projects; quotations/contracts/recurring billing; support; equipment/service history; completion reports, feedback and analytics.

name: OneCore AI
scope: Individual/business/institution/enterprise access; standalone/integrated use; hybrid billing; multi-provider gateway, routing/failover, private deployment, policies, usage/cost controls; chat, documents, summarization, data/spreadsheet analysis, visualization, BI, coding/SQL, voice/STT/TTS, image generation/understanding, file/PDF analysis, reports, forecasting, predictive insights, anomaly detection, automation, support, knowledge, extraction, decision support, search, agents and tool/API calls; English, Kiswahili, French, Arabic and extensible African languages; permission/tenant-aware governance, human approval, logs and retention.

name: OneCore Cloud
scope: Cloud file storage; organization storage; document management; upload/download/share/folders; permissions/versioning/preview/search; quotas; automated backups/verification; disaster recovery/restore; encryption; hosting/deployment and storage analytics/retention.

name: OneCore Connect
scope: REST APIs; docs; API keys; OAuth; webhooks/retries; rate limits/versioning; monitoring/sandbox; third-party connectors; M-Pesa/banks/SMS/email/WhatsApp/push/accounting/identity/SHA/eTIMS; external connectors, logs and error handling.

name: KRA eTIMS and Tax Management
scope: KRA PIN, branch/till and tax classification; VAT; invoice transmission via applicable authorized OSCU/VSCU method; KRA responses/identifiers/QR where required; credit/debit notes, corrections and permitted cancellations; supplier invoices; history/export; retries/duplicate prevention; VAT summaries, tax periods, estimates, reminders, payment references, authorized payment channels and reconciliation. Returns filing and tax payments are separate unless KRA explicitly authorizes APIs.

name: Payments and Financial Infrastructure
scope: M-Pesa STK Push/C2B/B2C; banks/cards/payment links/gateways; split/recurring payments; verification/callbacks/reconciliation; refunds; transaction history; duplicate protection; audit; optional wallet; multi-currency; settlement and reports.

name: Communication Centre

name: Website Builder and Digital Presence

name: OneCore E-commerce

name: Data Migration and Digital Transformation
